mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CVPL_REG_DT DESC) rnum, CVPL_NO AS cvplNo, CVPL_TY_CD AS cvplTyCd, CVPL_LOC AS cvplLoc, CVPL_CN AS cvplCn, CVPL_STTS_CD AS cvplSttsCd, CVPL_REG_DT AS cvplRegDt, CVPL_TTL AS cvplTtl, USER_NO AS userNo, HO_NO AS hoNo FROM CVPL WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CVPL ( CVPL_NO, CVPL_TY_CD, CVPL_LOC, CVPL_CN, CVPL_STTS_CD, CVPL_REG_DT, CVPL_TTL, USER_NO, HO_NO ) VALUES ( 'CV' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{cvplTyCd}, '미지정', #{cvplCn}, '접수', SYSDATE, #{cvplTtl}, #{userNo}, #{hoNo} )
